facts: BMC WebUI OEM firmware path uploads `.ima`, preserve config, flash and verify version.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL but changes OEM path to generic Firmware Update/Redfish assumption.
source_snapshot.v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE with OEM target and recovery.

original_test_intent.statement: Flash the designated CPLD image through the BMC OEM path and verify the exact CPLD version and platform recovery.
must_preserve: CPLD target and OEM update channel.
unknowns: Which CPLD/board, update order, activation power state, version source and rollback.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It should emphasize that multiple CPLDs may exist and OEM firmware semantics are not interchangeable with standard UpdateService.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Identify the physical CPLD/board and follow only its OEM update/activation sequence; generic Redfish substitution is prohibited.

revision_candidate.test_name: Flash the Designated CPLD Through the BMC OEM Path
revision_candidate.purpose: Update one explicitly mapped CPLD component with its signed image and prove correct version, required activation and platform power/management/device health.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact board assembly/CPLD hardware revision/BMC OEM updater combination.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One named CPLD at a physical board/location and component inventory ID; other CPLDs, BMC and BIOS excluded.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Board/CPLD identity and current/target version, image hash/signature/compatibility, OEM SOP/endpoint, dependency/update order, preserve-setting meaning, activation reset/DC/AC cycle, stable power, rollback/recovery and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture component/board/power baseline, verify image, use only OEM path, monitor complete task, perform only signed activation sequence, then query the same component and validate affected buses/devices.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Alternate management/power recovery and correct board/component map proven.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Physical/component mapping; image/hash; pre/post CPLD version from authoritative source; exact OEM task/messages; activation/power trace; BMC/host/PCIe/I2C/sensor/SEL health appropriate to affected CPLD.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Named CPLD reaches target version and all dependent platform paths recover; a generic firmware inventory version is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No generic standard endpoint assumption, wrong CPLD/image/order, power interruption outside activation, automatic retry or unrelated firmware flash.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: CPLD/platform owner approves component, image, activation and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: OEM UI/power activation or recovery may be manual.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On task/activation failure preserve state and use board-specific CPLD recovery; do not repeat blindly.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Component ambiguity, incompatible/signature-failed image, unsupported OEM path, dependency/power issue, task error, lost management or affected-bus/device failure.

identified_defects: Generic Redfish substitution changes OEM method.
reason_for_change: Servers often contain multiple CPLDs with board-specific update and activation rules; 'firmware version' without physical component identity can validate the wrong device.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide DSP2046
new_technical_evidence.supports: UpdateService describes advertised standard mechanisms, but OEM update paths and vendor-specific payloads remain implementation-specific.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: This CPLD OEM path and activation require vendor SOP.

removed_ambiguities: One physical CPLD target and affected paths must be named.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents an OEM CPLD workflow from being collapsed into generic Redfish firmware update and requires physical component plus dependent-bus validation.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently preserved one physical CPLD/component identity, OEM-only method, signed image/dependency order, exact reset/DC/AC activation, affected-path evidence, one attempt and board-specific recovery.
